summary: Cotton introduced the Israel Security Assistance Support Act (May 2024) to require weapons deliveries to Israel and the PLO and PA Terror Payments Accountability Act (January 2025) to sanction Palestinian institutions. On C-SPAN in April 2024 he said there was 'no evidence of genocide' in Gaza; in October 2023 he posted that everything in Gaza was Hamas's responsibility. He also cosponsored the 2025 Antisemitism Awareness Act, which directs the Education Department to use the IHRA definition for campus investigations.
